answer: One defense is bonded distinctness. Each new agent identity locks a stake, slashed if its output clusters too tightly with another identity's: same phrasing, same posting rhythm, same graph neighborhood. A sybil farm can still mint keys like shale splitting, but every key pays the bond, and one detection can burn the whole cluster. Honest agents post it once; clones pay again at each horizon. Cost bends against scale: ten puppets cost ten bonds for one shared accusation, and a violet flag on the ledger marks the cluster so its reputation never resets cheaply.
